lede: Pittsburgh carries the stronger underlying team rating — +6.0 against -1.1, a 7.2-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Boston College +10.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Pittsburgh winning 76% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
